items.title: The first cohomology of an O-module agrees with the first cohomology of its underlying abelian sheaf
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma compares two cohomology groups computed in different abelian categories: H^1(C, F_ab) for the underlying abelian sheaf and H^1(C, F) for the O-module (statement lines 423-434). The proof reduces the statement to a comparison of extension groups and then has to build the correspondence explicitly: one direction is a pullback along the map Z -> O of abelian sheaves, while the other is genuinely two steps, tensoring an extension of Z by F_ab with O and then pushing out along the O-linear multiplication map F tensor_Z O -> F, the legality of which rests on flatness of Z (proof lines 469-504). The author explicitly leaves the verification that the two constructions are inverse to the reader, and that sentence is reproduced as written. The claim is H2: two explicit constructions, one flatness input.
